subject: DPA & vendor-roster: notice window, eSign path
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: contracts@acme.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference, rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-12-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: DPA & vendor-roster: notice window, eSign path

Hi Emma / Acme contracts team,

Thanks for sending the DPA draft. We've reviewed and attached our redline (RI-DPA-v3-redline.pdf) plus our current vendor roster (vendor_roster_20261204.csv) so you can see overlap with our existing processors. Two quick items we need to lock before asking Procurement to sign:

- Notification window for any new vendors/processors that will process customer data: we prefer a 60-day review window for additions that involve processing of personal data or cross-border transfers, with the ability to object and request mitigation or replacement.
- eSign path: for audit and retention reasons we prefer DocuSign (envelope flow that records signer identity + certificate) and to have a two-signer flow (contracts + security). If you use AdobeSign we need confirmation that the audit trail will be provided in the envelope metadata.

Also: can you confirm whether any of the new vendors on your side will rely on EU->US measures (SCCs, encryption, or alternative safeguards)? Please point to the vendor entries in your roster if so.

If you can return a counter redline or an updated DPA we can route through internal approvals. Proposed next steps: you share counter, we agree on notice window, then we finalize esign envelope.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Sales & Privacy Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI-DPA-v3-redline.pdf (redline), vendor_roster_20261204.csv (roster)

From: Emma Lopez <emma@acme.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Cc: contracts@acme.com
Date: 2026-12-04T12:40:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA & vendor-roster: notice window, eSign path

Hi Aditya,

Appreciate the redline and roster. I've attached our counter (ACME-DPA-counter.pdf) with a few notes inline. High level: Acme is comfortable with a notification process but our standard practice is a 30-day notice for changes that are non-material and a 30/60 split for material additions; we flagged the two that we think are material. We can provide SCCs for EU transfers and we already use AWS (eu-west-1) and Databricks for analytics.

Regarding eSign: our legal team typically uses AdobeSign. If DocuSign is a hard requirement for Redwood we can run this through our procurement exception process, but it typically adds ~2 business days to execution. If you can accept AdobeSign please confirm and we'll attach the envelope ID once sent.

Please confirm whether 30 days is a non-starter on your side or whether there's room to meet in the middle.

Best,
Emma Lopez
Contracts Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachment: ACME-DPA-counter.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference, laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-12-04T14:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: DPA & vendor-roster: notice window, eSign path

Team — forwarding Acme's reply below. Short ask: legal/privacy input on (1) notice window (they propose 30 / we proposed 60), (2) whether AdobeSign vs DocuSign is acceptable if we require full audit metadata, and (3) any required contractual language for SCCs + fallback encryption clauses.

My negotiation intuition: we should try to push to at least a 45-day compromise for any new processors that actually touch personal data. For non-sensitive vendor additions (e.g., marketing tools that only see aggregated metrics) 30 days is probably fine. Also want a clause that requires them to provide a documented vendor risk assessment for any new processor we object to.

If legal signs off on 45 days + documented risk assessment + requirement for an auditable eSign trail, I can propose that back to Emma and ask them to update the envelope.

Thanks,
Aditya

On 2026-12-04 12:40, Emma Lopez wrote:
> Hi Aditya,
> 
> Appreciate the redline and roster...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-12-04T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA & vendor-roster: notice window, eSign path

Aditya — quick thoughts from legal:

- We can accept a compromise at 45 days for notice of new processors that will process PII. Insist on a written vendor risk assessment and a remediation plan for any processor we object to.
- Require that notification is sent to both security@redwood.inference and privacy@redwood.in so we have parallel tracking.
- AdobeSign is generally fine if Acme can provide the complete audit trail metadata (timestamps, signer certificate, IP). If they push back, require DocuSign or a contractual warrant that the audit trail meets DocuSign-equivalent evidentiary standards.
- For EU transfers, SCCs + encryption in transit and at rest are acceptable mitigation; add a clause that any transfer relying solely on SCCs will trigger an automatic review if the processor's location or controls materially change.

I'll draft a short addendum paragraph we can push into the DPA: notice window = 45 days, documentation requirement, and eSign audit trail warranty. If you want to hold for full 60 days that is negotiable but will likely slow execution; 45 days is pragmatic given the sales timeline on HS-2026-309.

-karthik

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@acme.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference, laura_bennett@redwood.inference, rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-12-04T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA & vendor-roster: notice window, eSign path

Emma — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the counter. Summary of our position after internal review:

1) Notice window: we can compromise to 45 days for any new processors that will handle personal data. Non-material changes can remain at 30 days — we'll ask you to tag items in the roster as "material" when they meet that threshold.
2) Documentation: Acme will need to supply a vendor risk assessment for any new processor we flag, and a remediation plan for any gaps.
3) eSign: we prefer DocuSign but will accept AdobeSign if you attach the full audit trail (signer certificates, timestamps, IP, envelope metadata) to the final executed package. If AdobeSign doesn't provide that, we'll need DocuSign or an exception.
4) EU transfers: SCCs + standard encryption controls are acceptable; add a 'material change' trigger if controls or location change.

If this is agreeable, please (a) update the DPA to reflect the 45/30 split and the documentation requirement, (b) attach the eSign envelope (DocuSign preferred) or confirm AdobeSign audit export, and (c) add a one-line note in the DPA referencing the vendor roster entries that you flagged as material. Once we have that I will route HS-2026-309 to Procurement and Security for final sign-off.

Proposed next step: share updated DPA + eSign link and I'll confirm internal approvals. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HS-2026-309.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Sales & Privacy Ops
Redwood Inference
